testcase.name: a stored update is reflected while the state is being collected
collecting replaces the defaults with the stored weights and clears loading
a throwing observation stream falls back to defaults without hanging on loading
saving an all-zero weighting never reaches the repository
saving an out-of-range weighting never reaches the repository
a refused save is silent, it does not surface as an error state
a failed save escapes the coroutine scope instead of being reported
before collection the state is loading with the built-in defaults
a valid save is forwarded unchanged
